shared_elements: more than one figure/face present on the surface
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic one that both surfaces carry relief figures with heads seen in profile and bent arms, plus a second figure/face beside the main one. A depicts two fully human, richly costumed figures confronting each other in a ritual offering with a bowl and staff, rendered with fine naturalistic detail and incised drapery, while B shows a single bold, schematic crouching creature with a large beaked/bird head filling the boulder, with no interaction, no attributes and no interior detailing.
